q: The process of changing liquid into vapour is called _____.
e: Vaporization is the process of changing a liquid into a vapour.

q: The temperature at which a liquid vaporizes under normal pressure is called its _____.
e: The boiling point is the temperature at which a liquid vaporizes under normal pressure.

q: Heat that must be supplied to change 1 kg of liquid at its boiling point from liquid phase to vapour phase is called the specific latent heat of _____.
e: Specific latent heat of vaporization is the heat required to change 1 kg of liquid at its boiling point to vapour.

q: The exact value of the specific latent heat of vaporization of water is _____ J kg$^{-1}$.
e: The specific latent heat of vaporization of water is exactly $2.255 \times 10^6$ J kg$^{-1}$.

q: The change of vapour or gas phase into liquid phase is called _____.
e: Condensation is the change of a vapour or gas phase back into a liquid phase.
During condensation, the substance releases heat into its surroundings.
During vaporization, the substance absorbs heat from its surroundings.
